_note: Company background for captions. Taken from the live site pages in this repository (about, services, capabilities). Only plain descriptive statements: no figures, tolerances, lead times or claims about any particular job. Edit this file when the website changes.
name: J.N.R. Engineering
statements: J.N.R. Engineering is a family run engineering firm in Hamilton.
The workshop offers CNC milling, CNC turning, water jet profiling, fabrication and inspection.
Parts are machined in plastics, copper, aluminium, stainless and hardened steel.
Fabrication is in mild steel, stainless or aluminium.
Work ranges from single prototypes to production batches.
Every part is measured against the customer's drawing before it leaves the workshop.
voice: Plain, practical UK English. Short sentences. Written by the workshop, not a marketing department. No hype, no emojis, no exclamation marks.
